# Is your pay gap over the 5% line the EU Pay Transparency Directive draws?

> Free calculator for the EU Pay Transparency Directive: paste your payroll table and get the mean and median gender pay gap, variable pay gap, pay quartiles and the gap by job category with the 5% joint assessment flag. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/eu-pay-gap-report-calculator/)
